title: Procurement Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role manages supplier follow-up after order placement, covering production stages, fabrics, price negotiations, and replenishment orders. It requires close collaboration with suppliers to ensure alignment with SHEIN processes, assess capacity, and support continuous improvements. Strong communication skills and experience working with spreadsheets and data-driven processes are essential.


Responsabilities:

  • Coordinate with designers on new product development, manage monthly first production orders, and ensure sufficient new SKCs for design updates.
  • Manage relationships with assigned garment suppliers, ensure on-time bulk order delivery, and support issue resolution throughout the production process.
  • Support the hunting team in meeting ESG requirements by driving supplier remediation and improving ESG ratings.
  • Analyze production and performance data to help suppliers improve capacity, quality, and delivery timeliness.
  • Establish, optimize, and maintain bulk order operational standards, including system SOPs, and deliver training to order coordinators and suppliers.
  • Continuously improve supply chain processes by identifying optimization opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve lead times.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the apparel industry.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong understanding of garment production processes across all categories, with the ability to resolve production issues.
  • Excellent data analysis skills with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills to drive improvements in delivery performance, quality, and cost efficiency.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Jornalista De Entretenimento & Política
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) jornalista sênior , com forte vivência digital , perfil executivo altamente organizado e experiência na área comercial comprovada , para atuar na gestão, estruturação e monetização de múltiplos projetos editoriais e digitais do Canal Matheus Baldi (Instagram, Youtube, TikTok, Kwai e Spotify).


Buscamos um(a) profissional com disponibilidade integral para assumir a gestão executiva, comercial e operacional dos projetos. Essa é uma posição de altíssima responsabilidade.


Procuramos alguém com mentalidade de dono , compromisso com metas e resultado e enorme disposição .


Modelo PJ | Dedicação integral aos projetos


Atenção: Essa não é uma vaga para redator ou social media. Busco alguém com perfil executivo que tenha experiência em organizar projetos, liderar equipe e gerar receita com vendas de cotas publicitárias.


Missão da Posição:

Transformar visão editorial em operação estruturada e receita recorrente.

A pessoa será responsável por organizar fluxos, coordenar equipes, desenvolver oportunidades comerciais e garantir que todas as frentes operem com método, clareza e resultado.


Principais frentes sob responsabilidade:

- Organização de cronogramas, fluxos e calendário estratégico de projetos digitais e audiovisuais

- Implantação, monitoramento e consolidação de relatórios

- Desenvolvimento e estruturação comercial de formatos, cotas e integrações

- Prospecção ativa de marcas e parceiros estratégicos

- Condução de reuniões comerciais e negociações

- Elaboração de propostas personalizadas

- Venda de projetos e acompanhamento do fechamento até a entrega final

- Controle de metas comerciais e acompanhamento de resultados

- Curadoria e organização diária de conteúdo sobre bastidores da fama (celebridades) e do poder (política e mercado)

- Supervisão e revisão de roteiros, legendas e narrativas multiplataforma

- Estruturação de crescimento estratégico em redes sociais (com foco em X)

- Gestão operacional de comunidade e integração com estratégia de relacionamento e monetização

- Coordenação de equipe (assistente, edição e comercial)

- Criação e manutenção de sistema estruturado de gestão

- Garantia de alinhamento entre conteúdo, comercial e entregas

- Relacionamento e acompanhamento de projetos com marcas das quais Matheus Baldi tem contrato

Perfil que buscamos:

- Formação em Jornalismo ou Comunicação Social

- Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência digital comprovada

- Excelente redação e domínio narrativo

- Experiência com jornalismo de celebridades e bastidores política/mercado

- Experiência organizando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

- Forte capacidade comercial e de negociação

- Conforto em trabalhar com metas e geração de receita

- Alta capacidade de organização e controle de dados

- Autonomia e postura resolutiva

- Mentalidade de dono e visão estratégica

Criatividade é bem-vinda, mas organização, execução e comercial são as prioridades.

Atenção! Formato híbrido, com predominância de trabalho remoto (cerca de 80%) e encontros presenciais pontuais. Mas, é preciso que more em São Paulo (capital) ou na Grande São Paulo.


Modelo de remuneração:

Prestação de serviço (PJ), com remuneração fixa mensal compatível com senioridade.

Além do fixo:

Participação de 3% sobre todos os contratos captados e vendidos diretamente pelo(a) profissional .

O pagamento da participação acompanha a forma de recebimento acordada com o cliente, respeitando parcelas e prazos definidos em contrato.

Buscamos alguém que compreenda metas, receita e crescimento sustentável.


Não é a vaga ideal se:

- Você prefere apenas escrever e não negociar

- Não tem experiência real em vendas ou captação

- Nunca organizou múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

- Precisa de supervisão constante

- Trabalha apenas por carga horária

- Não tem experiência sólida em jornalismo digital

Essa posição exige maturidade profissional, responsabilidade e visão de negócio.


Como se candidatar:


Favor enviar:


  1. Portfólio com 3 a 8 links de trabalhos publicados (matérias, vídeos, campanhas e/ou projetos digitais), indicando sua função em cada um deles.
  2. Breve descrição de um projeto que você estruturou do zero
  3. Exemplo de propostas comerciais que você já tenha desenvolvido
  4. Resposta objetiva (até 10 linhas): “Como você organizaria múltiplos projetos editoriais simultâneos e ao mesmo tempo desenvolveria a frente comercial?”

Enviar para o e-mail: (Precisa enviar tudo por e-mail)


Colocar no título do e-mail: Head Projetos & Comercial


*Fundamental informar sua pretensão salarial no e-mail e disponibilidade para início do trabalho (temos urgência).


*Candidaturas sem portfólio, exemplo de proposta comercial e resposta à pergunta estratégica não serão analisadas.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.G. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required;
    fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques

title: Pessoa engenheira de gestão de ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.
No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

e sustentável.

técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis

title: Python tech lead - remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.
Overview of the role:We are looking for Python Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!
These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.Key responsibilities:- Work closely alongside their Engineering and Business Stakeholders to support the delivery of the project.
- Be able to manage your time effectively to focus on coding as well as supporting junior members.
- Integrate with the Dev Ops team to maintain tasks.
- Make architectural decisions keeping the future of a growing business in mind.Requirements:- 7+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.
- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.
- 3 years of development using other programming languages.
- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / My SQL).
- Experience with OOD.
- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.
- A University Degree in systems is a plus.
- Advanced English level.Benefits:
• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.
